id: 07_Test Your Fire Extinguisher Safety Knowledge Fire Extinguisher Safety Quiz Fire
title: 灭火器十问：选对、拿稳、用好（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/07_Test Your Fire Extinguisher Safety Knowledge Fire Extinguisher Safety Quiz Fire.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/07_Test Your Fire Extinguisher Safety Knowledge Fire Extinguisher Safety Quiz Fire（国内版）/src.py

points.K5: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
points.S1: 国内外火灾分类不一样
points.S4: 灭火器取用的人机工效

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一具灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a red fire extinguisher and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 灭火器十问，选对、拿稳、用好！
overlay: 灭火器十问：选对、拿稳、用好

shots.scene: 实验室角落的灭火器被纸箱挡住，阿杰找不到
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory corner, a fire extinguisher is hidden behind stacked cardboard boxes; the young male student looks around for it.
shots.narration: 演练时，阿杰半天找不到灭火器。

shots.scene: 找到后，阿杰对着铭牌发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finally pulls out the extinguisher and stares at its blank label, confused.
shots.narration: 找到了，又看不懂能灭哪类火。

shots.scene: 王老师走来，拿起题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a stack of blank quiz cards.
shots.narration: 王老师说：来，十道题讲明白。

shots.scene: 十张空白题卡，灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank quiz cards with a small fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题，一题一题来。

shots.scene: 四个选项图标：跑开的人、拿灭火器的新手、留在屋里的人、报警按钮和电话
shots.prompt_en: Four option icons: a person running away alone, a beginner grabbing an extinguisher, a person staying inside, and an alarm button with a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：发现火情，第一步做什么？

shots.scene: 报警按钮和电话图标亮起打勾，其他三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: The alarm button and phone icon glows with a green check; the other three are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 按下报警按钮，拨打火警电话。

shots.scene: 一个人独自跑开、别人没察觉的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person running off while others remain unaware, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能自己跑掉，不提醒别人。

shots.scene: 从没用过灭火器的人硬上，图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person nervously holding an extinguisher upside down, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 没学过就别硬上，更别留在屋里琢磨。

shots.scene: 四个手势：拔销、对准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons: pulling a pin, aiming a nozzle, squeezing a handle and sweeping. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：四步口诀是什么？

shots.scene: 小研在培训场依次完成四步
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student performs the four steps in order at a fire training ground.
shots.narration: 拔销、对准、压把、左右扫。

shots.scene: 火焰分顶部、中部、根部三段，喷嘴对准根部
shots.prompt_en: A flame divided into top, middle and base sections, with a nozzle aimed at the base. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：喷嘴对准哪里？

shots.scene: 对准火苗顶部的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of spraying at the top of the flames, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 对准根部，烧着的东西才会灭。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器，长喇叭筒
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide fire extinguisher with a long horn-shaped nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火？
overlay: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 液体、气体、带电仪器三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a burning liquid, a gas flame and an electrical instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 液体火、气体火和带电设备火都适用。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 原题答案卡片：B和C
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card with two highlighted letters. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答B和C，是按国外分类说的。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 小研用二氧化碳灭火器喷向仪器，手握把手而非喇叭筒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher on a small instrument fire, holding the handle, not the horn.
shots.narration: 不留残渣，适合仪器；别握喇叭筒防冻伤。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 小房间里大量喷放的图标，人头晕
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small closed room filled with discharged gas and a dizzy person. No people.
shots.narration: 狭小房间大量喷放，人要尽快离开。

shots.section_title: 国内外火灾分类不一样
shots.scene: 两排分类卡片：上排国内六类，下排国外五类
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of category cards with icons: the top row has six icons, the bottom row has five. No text. No people.
shots.narration: 国内外的火灾分类不一样。
overlay: 国内外火灾分类不一样

shots.section_title: 国内外火灾分类不一样
shots.scene: 国内：A固体、B液体、C气体、D金属、E带电、F烹饪油
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: a wooden block, a liquid drop, a gas flame, a metal bar, a lightning bolt and a frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 国内分六类，C类是气体火。

shots.section_title: 国内外火灾分类不一样
shots.scene: 国外C类卡片上画闪电，国内C类卡片上画气体火焰
shots.prompt_en: Two cards side by side: one with a lightning bolt, one with a gas flame, and an arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 国外的C类，是带电设备火。

shots.section_title: 国内外火灾分类不一样
shots.scene: 王老师指着铭牌，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to the blank label on an extinguisher with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 看灭火器铭牌，按国内分类为准。

shots.scene: 小研灭火，身后是安全出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fights a small fire with the emergency exit behind her.
shots.narration: 第五题：出口要留在身后，对吗？

shots.scene: 对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A large green check mark beside the exit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 对！火控制不住，转身就撤。

shots.scene: 火三角：氧气、可燃物、热源
shots.prompt_en: A red triangle with an oxygen icon, a fuel icon and a heat icon on its sides. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：火三角是哪三样？

shots.scene: 水和土的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon and a soil icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气、可燃物、热源，没有水和土。

shots.scene: 木头、纸张、布料图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of wood, paper and cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：A类火烧的是什么？

shots.scene: 三样东西放进A类框
shots.prompt_en: The three items drop into one box with a solid block icon. No people.
shots.narration: 普通固体可燃物，木头纸张布料。

shots.scene: 一具干粉灭火器，铭牌上三个空白方块
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher with three blank squares on its label. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：ABC干粉能灭哪些火？

shots.scene: 固体、液体、气体三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wooden block, a liquid drop and a gas flame, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 固体、液体、气体火都能灭。

shots.scene: 精密仪器被粉末覆盖的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a precision instrument covered in white powder. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点是粉末难清理，会损坏仪器。

shots.scene: 水型灭火器喷水，温度计下降
shots.prompt_en: A water fire extinguisher spraying with a thermometer dropping beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：水型灭火器靠什么灭火？

shots.scene: 冷却图标亮起，其他三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: The cooling icon lights up; icons for oxygen exclusion, fuel removal and chain breaking are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 靠冷却，把温度降下来。

shots.scene: 水泼向带电仪器和油火的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of water sprayed onto an electrical instrument and onto burning oil, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备、油火和活泼金属，不能用水。

shots.scene: 四种灭火器图标：水型、干粉、哈龙、泡沫
shots.prompt_en: Four extinguisher icons: water, dry powder, halon and foam. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：最常见的灭火器是哪种？

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: The dry powder extinguisher glows with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉灭火器，适用范围广。

shots.scene: 哈龙灭火器被放进回收箱，臭氧层图标
shots.prompt_en: The halon extinguisher is placed into a recycling box next to an ozone layer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 哈龙破坏臭氧层，已基本淘汰。

shots.scene: 实验室平面图，不同区域放不同灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory floor plan with different extinguisher icons placed in different zones. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器要按场所的危险来选。

shots.scene: 精密仪器室配二氧化碳，化学实验室配干粉
shots.prompt_en: An instrument room with a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a chemistry lab with a dry powder extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器室多用二氧化碳，化学实验室常配干粉。

shots.scene: 活泼金属旁放着干沙桶
shots.prompt_en: A bucket of dry sand placed next to a cabinet for reactive metals. No people.
shots.narration: 活泼金属旁，备干沙等专用器材。

shots.scene: 老李查看压力表指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks that the pressure gauge needle on an extinguisher is in the green zone.
shots.narration: 压力表指针要在绿区。

shots.scene: 检查保险销、铅封、喷管
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the safety pin, seal and hose of an extinguisher being inspected.
shots.narration: 保险销、铅封完好，喷管没裂没堵。

shots.scene: 空白检查卡片，日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection tag hanging on the extinguisher with a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定定期检查、维修和报废。

shots.section_title: 灭火器取用的人机工效
shots.scene: 灭火器挂在门口显眼处，前面通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher mounted in a visible spot near the laboratory door with a clear path in front. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器放在显眼、顺手的地方。
overlay: 灭火器取用的人机工效

shots.section_title: 灭火器取用的人机工效
shots.scene: 纸箱挡住灭火器的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boxes blocking an extinguisher, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面不堆东西，伸手就能拿到。

shots.section_title: 灭火器取用的人机工效
shots.scene: 小研屈膝、双手提起灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends her knees and lifts the extinguisher with both hands by the handle.
shots.narration: 屈膝提起，一手握把一手握管。

shots.section_title: 灭火器取用的人机工效
shots.scene: 推车式灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A wheeled fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 大型推车式的，至少两人配合。

shots.scene: 学生排队在培训场轮流练习
shots.prompt_en: Students line up at a fire training ground and take turns practicing with an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 灭火器要练过才会用。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次成功灭掉训练火盆，开心
shots.prompt_en: The young male student successfully puts out a training tray fire and smiles.
shots.narration: 参加学校组织的消防培训和演练。

shots.scene: 王老师合上空白法规书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank law book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 消防法要求单位开展培训，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with extinguisher icons.
shots.narration: 十题答完，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 图标：报警、四步、火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: Icons: an alarm button, four step icons and a flame base target. No people.
shots.narration: 先报警，四步走，对准根部。

shots.scene: 图标：六类火、铭牌
shots.prompt_en: Icons: six fire category icons and an extinguisher label. No people.
shots.narration: 按国内六类火，看铭牌选灭火器。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱搬开，灭火器露出来，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the boxes away to reveal the extinguisher and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：先把灭火器前面清出来！

shots.scene: 欣欣把灭火器挂回墙上，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hangs the extinguisher back on the wall and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 选对、拿稳、用好，下次见！
